name: I got GOONED by a FEMBOY
source:
Late night and you can't sleep.

You decide to browse a popular Dating App to see what's out there. If nothing else, it'll help get you sleepy. And who knows, maybe you'll find some inspiration for some alternative remedy.

Ready, Set, GOON!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2772650/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
夜深了，你睡不着。

你决定浏览一个流行的约会应用程序，看看有什么。如果不出意外的话，它会帮助你入睡。谁知道呢，也许你会找到一些替代疗法的灵感。

准备好，出发，出发！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2772650/]Steam[/url]]
